title: Position: Evaluating Generative AI Systems Is a Social Science Measurement Challenge

bias_targets.methodology: The paper presents a theoretical framework for measurement using a running example of evaluating text that stereotypes social groups. The proposed methodology involves systematizing the concept of stereotyping through specific linguistic patterns (e.g., essentializing descriptions, caricatures, prescribing/proscribing behaviors) and operationalizing it via an LLM-as-a-judge system equipped with detailed annotation guidelines to aggregate the prevalence of stereotypes in chatbot outputs.
